description: Choose this for broad website testing when the caller wants screenshots, responsive layout checks, accessibility findings, console/network errors, performance evidence, and a release diagnosis across phone portrait, phone landscape, and desktop. For explicit pass/fail assertions use verify_page instead. Costs $0.08 USDC via x402.
